correctness.rationale: Explicit iff lemma: C=ker H has no weight n or n-1 iff s=H1 is nonzero and no column h_i equals s. Complete nontrivial-character calculation gives F_j(n)=((2^j-1)^n-epsilon)/2^j. Binary subspace-lattice Möbius inversion extracts spanning n-tuples, and the free GL_r action removes all parity-check multiplicities. Independently ran RREF parity-check enumeration for n<=8 (every r) and direct generator-codeword weight enumeration n<=7 (every r), obtaining agreement; unrestricted theorem rests on the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: First nontrivial full-distance deficit (n-d=2) admits a uniform exact count for every binary linear-code dimension. It makes the newly studied anticode enumeration dimension-resolved and gives a simple parity-dependent expression for the first nonoptimal codimension r=3, along with an exponentially precise fixed-r rarity law. This has a natural motivated target beyond textbook bound checking, without claiming applications or a general codiameter formula.
